title: set_mode_response
description: MQTT response for the set_mode command. REST PUT /cloud/mode returns an empty string on success.

command.description: MQTT command name that was executed

command_id.description: Unique identifier correlating this response to the original request

code.description: Reader error code returned on failure

payload.description: Empty on success; contains code and message on failure

response.description: Response status indicating success or failure
